title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do players that sign minor league deals have options?
Depends. The two things are not related. A player has or doesn’t have options regardless of what type of contract he signs. I can explain in person better
But essentially, if a player has used options previously, it counts on whatever next deal they sign, even if it’s minors
Correct once you use your options you’ve used them. But options are only for 40-man players
